carpet.rule.fakePlayerChunkPriority.desc: Chunks around Carpet fake players load before real players' chunks.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerChunkPriority.extr: Bots get their own loading ticket throttler (4 chunks at a time per dimension, like vanilla), not shared with real players,
and their worldgen and light tasks run ahead of real players', nearest to the bot first.
Which chunks are loaded and at what level stays the same as in vanilla.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerChunkUpdateEveryTi: Fake players move their loaded area every tick they cross a chunk section, like real players.
Carpet only does it every 10 ticks, so a fast bot runs into chunks that are not loaded yet.
